facts.text: Evan recently purchased a new Prius and went on a family trip to the Rockies.

evidence.quote: Hey Sam! Good to see you! Yeah, I just got back from a trip with my family in my new Prius.
Glad you asked, we went to Rockies, check it out.

facts.text: Evan's old Prius broke down, leading him to decide to repair and sell it.

evidence.quote: My old prius broke down, decided to get it repaired and sell it.

facts.text: During the trip to the Rockies, Evan and his family hiked the trails and enjoyed the views.

evidence.quote: We all hiked the trails last week - the views were amazing.
